definitions.gloss: revolution; orbital motion of one body around another
definitions.explanation: In astronomy, the orbital motion of one body around another — typically a planet around its star or a moon around its planet. Distinct from {自転|じてん} ("rotation on the body's own axis"). Earth's annual {公転|こうてん} around the Sun produces the seasons.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}は{太陽|たいよう}の{周|まわ}りを{公転|こうてん}している。
examples.english: The Earth revolves around the Sun.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}は{地球|ちきゅう}の{周|まわ}りを{公転|こうてん}している。
examples.english: The Moon revolves around the Earth.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}の{公転|こうてん}{周期|しゅうき}は{約|やく}365{日|にち}だ。
examples.english: Earth's orbital period is about 365 days.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変化|へんか}は、{地球|ちきゅう}の{自転|じてん}{軸|じく}が{傾|かたむ}いたまま{太陽|たいよう}を{公転|こうてん}しているために{生|しょう}じる。
examples.english: The seasons arise because the Earth orbits the Sun while keeping its rotation axis tilted.

notes:
{公転|こうてん} is the standard astronomical term for orbital revolution — one body moving around another under gravity. It is taught and used as a pair with {自転|じてん} ("rotation on the body's own axis"); Japanese science textbooks contrast the two side by side.

FORMS:
- {公|こう} (here functioning roughly as "public, around a center") + {転|てん} ("turn, revolve") → {公転|こうてん}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公転|こうてん}する: to revolve, to orbit
- {公転|こうてん}{周期|しゅうき}: orbital period
- {公転|こうてん}{軌道|きどう}: orbital path
- {公転|こうてん}{速度|そくど}: orbital speed
- {太陽|たいよう}の{周|まわ}りを{公転|こうてん}する: to orbit the Sun
- {地球|ちきゅう}の{公転|こうてん}: the Earth's revolution

CONTRAST WITH {自転|じてん}:
- {自転|じてん}: rotation on its own axis — produces day and night
- {公転|こうてん}: revolution around another body — produces the year, the seasons (when combined with axial tilt), and the lunar month
- The two are usually introduced together; "{自転|じてん}と{公転|こうてん}" is essentially a fixed phrase in astronomy class.

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {軌道|きどう}: orbit (the path itself, as a noun)
- {周回|しゅうかい}: circling around (used for satellites, e.g., {地球|ちきゅう}を{周回|しゅうかい}する)
- {回転|かいてん}: rotation, turning (general, non-astronomical use)
- {太陽系|たいようけい}: the solar system

USAGE:
- {公転|こうてん} is restricted to astronomy and physics. For "go around" in everyday contexts, {周|まわ}る or {周回|しゅうかい} is used: {湖|みずうみ}を{周|まわ}る ("to go around the lake").
- The pattern is typically [orbiting body]が[central body]の{周|まわ}りを{公転|こうてん}する: {月|つき}が{地球|ちきゅう}の{周|まわ}りを{公転|こうてん}する.
- Several homophones share the reading こうてん: {好転|こうてん} ("a turn for the better"), {交点|こうてん} ("point of intersection"), {荒天|こうてん} ("stormy weather"). Distinguish them by kanji and context.
